title: UP NTSE Online Form 2020 Last Date : 10/11/2020

postName: National Talent Search Examination (NTSE) State Level – UP
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process

howToApply:
1. Visit SCERT UP / NTSE application portal (as notified in 2020)
2. Register Class 10 student details
3. Get school verification

5. Last date was 10 November 2020 for that cycle
shortDescription: UP NTSE Online Form 2020 – last date 10 Nov 2020. State-level National Talent Search Exam for Class 10.
content:
NTSE is a national scholarship exam for Class 10 students. State-level Stage-I is conducted by SCERT/education boards.

UP NTSE 2020 online applications closed on 10 November 2020. For current year schedules, check SCERT UP / NCERT notifications.
